name: kirchner.ink
notes: Static Next export (output: 'export'). No env file, no backend: every page renders from content/*.json and markdown at build time. Netlify-only features (Open Readings answer form, admin console) post to Netlify functions and are inert locally. No X-Frame-Options or basePath in dev; the SAMEORIGIN/CSP headers in netlify.toml apply only on Netlify. `npx serve out` serves clean URLs (/work/x -> work/x.html) and byte ranges (the PDF viewers range-load). The review mode (/work/the-subjects-unanswered-plea) serves ~1 GB of PDFs from public/uploads; the static build takes ~1 min. `pages` (additive, read by the Studio's DEVICES run, frontend-developer a168bcf6 2026-09-15): `exclude` = owner console, Netlify functions and the raw per-PDF viewer chrome; `heavy` = pages that fetch a manifest and a PDF (the work/review pages, the archive leaves) and get the run's longer settle.
